title: UAAP: Mason Amos lauds Tope Lagat, UE’s fight in La Salle’s OT win

blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—La Salle forward Mason Amos had plenty of praise for University of the East after their grind-it-out overtime duel in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Mall of Asia Arena on Wednesday. After Green Archers’ 97-88 win, Amos gave credit to the winless UE squad, particularly Tope Lagat, who kept the Red Warriors in contention for much of the game. “UE played a hell of a game. Lagat hit some big shots too,” he said, after steering La Salle to 4-4. “You can’t take away any credit from them […]...
